description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a popular fried chicken chain with a location on Main Street in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood. The restaurant is takeout-oriented with no drive-through, making it a straightforward stop for a quick meal. Cyclists on the Main Street corridor will find it convenient for a calorie-dense refuel.
